title: Marriage alliances for Bharata and Shatrughna
introduction: Vishvamitra proposes the marriages of Bharata ad Shatrughna with the two daughters of Kushadhvaja, the younger brother of Janaka. This being a welcome offer, Janaka accords his immediate consent. Then Dasharatha proceeds with the initiatory rituals for the bridegrooms and donates cows and riches.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्विसप्ततितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 72nd chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तमुक्तवंतं वैदेहं विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः |
उवाच वचनं वीरं वसिष्ठसहितो नृपम्
verses.iast:
tam uktavantam vaideham viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ |
uvāca vacanam vīram vasiṣṭha sahito nṛpam
verses.translation: Then the eminent-saint Vishvamitra together with Vashishta said these words to Janaka, the valiant king of Videha, who has just said about his lineage.

glosses.meaning: to one who said [about his lineage, Janaka]

verses.devanagari:
अचिंत्यान्यप्रमेयाणि कुलानि नरपुंगव |
इक्ष्वाकूणां विदेहानां नैषां तुल्योऽस्ति कश्चन
verses.iast:
acintyāni aprameyāṇi kulāni narapuṅgava |
ikṣvākūṇām videhānām na eṣām tulyo asti kaścana
verses.translation: "The Ikshvaku-s and Videha-s are unimaginably admirable and immeasurably distinguished dynasties, oh, Janaka, the best one among all men, there is no single king comparable to one from these dynasties...

glosses.meaning: to them - kings of dynasties, comparable king

verses.devanagari:
सदृशो धर्मसंबन्धः सदृशो रूपसंपदा |
रामलक्ष्मणयो राजन् सीता चोर्मिलया सह
verses.iast:
sadṛśo dharma sambandhaḥ sadṛśo rūpa sampadā |
rāma lakṣmaṇayo rājan sītā ca ūrmilayā saha
verses.translation: "Oh, king Janaka, these espousals of Seetha with Rama and Urmila with Lakshmana is behovely to each other's dynastical prestige and even it is befitting to the winsome charms of the brides and bridegrooms, but that being so...

glosses.meaning: by winsome, charms [of brides and bridegrooms,] befitting, even.

verses.devanagari:
वक्तव्यं च नरश्रेष्ठ श्रूयतां वचनं मम |
भ्राता यवीयान् धर्मज्ञ एष राजा कुशध्वजः
verses.iast:
vaktavyam ca nara śreṣṭha śrūyatām vacanam mama |
bhrātā yavīyān dharmajña eṣa rājā kuśadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, grand sire, you may listen to my words of advise... this younger brother of yours, king Kushadhvaja, is at home in every kind of probity...

glosses.meaning: oh, man, the best [grand sire, that being so]

verses.devanagari:
अस्य धर्मात्मनो राजन् रूपेणाप्रतिमं भुवि |
सुताद्वयं नरश्रेष्ठ पत्न्यर्थं वरयामहे
verses.iast:
asya dharmātmano rājan rūpeṇa apratimam bhuvi |
sutā dvayam naraśreṣṭha patni artham varayāmahe
verses.translation: "Oh, king, the pair of daughters of this right-minded Kushadhvaja is nonpareil in comeliness in this world, hence, oh, grand sire, we choose to pair them off with Bharata and Shatrughna...

glosses.meaning: by looks, in world, not, matchable [nonpareil]
wife for the purpose of[to pair off with Bharata and Shatrughna,] we choose.

verses.devanagari:
भरतस्य कुमारस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य च धीमतः |
वरयेम सुते राजंस्तयोरर्थे महात्मनोः
verses.iast:
bharatasya kumārasya śatrughnasya ca dhīmataḥ |
varayema sute rājan tayoḥ arthe mahātmanoḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, king, for the sake of those two honourable boys, for that young man Bharata and for that smart man Shatrughna, we opt your brother's daughters...

verses.devanagari:
पुत्रा दशरथस्येमे रूपयौवनशालिनः |
लोकपालसमाः सर्वे देवतुल्यपराक्रमाः
verses.iast:
putrā daśarathasya ime rūpa yauvana śālinaḥ |
loka pāla samāḥ sarve deva tulya parākramāḥ
verses.translation: "All these four sons of Dasharatha have handsomeness and youthfulness, and they are equal to the four rulers of the world from four quarters, and their valour vies with the valour of God Vishnu...

glosses.meaning: god [Vishnu's valour,] vie with, valorous ones.

verses.devanagari:
उभयोरपि राजेन्द्र संबन्धेनानुबध्यताम् |
इक्ष्वाकोः कुलमव्यग्रं भवतः पुण्यकर्मणः
verses.iast:
ubhayoḥ api rājendra sambandhena anubadhyatām |
ikṣvāku kulam avyagram bhavataḥ puṇya karmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, best king, let both theses dynasties of yours, the impeccable dynasty of Ikshvaku-s and the immaculate dynasty of yours as well, be interlocked by these wedlock-s..." Thus Vishvamitra advised Janaka.

glosses.meaning: [having] pious, deeds, your [dynasty, ] as well - is an immaculate one
by alliance [wed-locks], not, loosely [compactly,] let them be interlocked.

verses.devanagari:
विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठस्य मते तदा |
जनकः प्रांजलिर्वाक्यमुवाच मुनिपुंगवौ
verses.iast:
viśvāmitra vacaḥ śrutvā vasiṣṭhasya mate tadā |
janakaḥ prāñjaliḥ vākyam uvāca munipuṅgavau
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vishvamitra that have the concurrence of Vashishta then Janaka reverently said this to those two eminent-saints.

glosses.meaning: to two eminent-saints - Vishvamitra and Vashishta

verses.devanagari:
कुलं धन्यमिदं मन्ये येषां तौ मुनिपुंगवौ |
सदृशं कुलसंबन्धं यदाज्ञापयथः स्वयम्
verses.iast:
kulam dhanyam idam manye yeṣām tau munipuṅgavau |
sadṛśam kula sambandham yat ājñāpayathaḥ svayam
verses.translation: "By which reason you two eminent-saints personally bid fair to this befitting proposal, thereby I opine that my dynasty is highly honoured...

glosses.meaning: dynasty [of mine,] highly honoured, I opine.

verses.devanagari:
एवं भवतु भद्रं वः कुशध्वजसुते इमे |
पत्न्यौ भजेतां सहितौ शत्रुघ्नभरतावुभौ
verses.iast:
evam bhavatu bhadram vaḥ kuśadhvaja sute ime |
patnyau bhajetām sahitau śatrughna bharatau ubhau
verses.translation: "So be it! Safe betides you all! Let the pair of Kushdhvaja's daughters, namely Maandavi, Shrutakiirti, devout themselves as a pair of wives to the paired brothers, namely Bharata and Shatrughna, respectively...

glosses.meaning: being together [brothers in perfect accord, paired brothers]

verses.devanagari:
एकाह्ना राजपुत्रीणां चतसॄणां महामुने |
पाणीन् गृह्णन्तु चत्वारो राजपुत्रा महाबलाः
verses.iast:
eka ahnā rāja putrīṇām catasṝṇām mahāmune |
pāṇīn gṛhṇantu catvāro rāja putrā mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, eminent-saint Vishvamitra, let the palms of four princesses be taken in the palms of these four mettlesome princes in marriage, in the light of one day...

glosses.meaning: hand, take into hand [i.e., marry the princesses, assume husband-ship.]

verses.devanagari:
उत्तरे दिवसे ब्रह्मन् फल्गुनीभ्यां मनीषिणः |
वैवाहिकं प्रशंसन्ति भगो यत्र प्रजापतिः
verses.iast:
uttare divase brahman phalgunībhyām manīṣiṇaḥ |
vaivāhikam praśaṃsanti bhago yatra prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Brahman, the savants acclaim that part of the day as the best for wedding ceremonies when both of the pre-Phalguni and post-Phalguni stars are available, and on such a time where post-Phalguni is ruling, for which Bhaga is the presiding deity for progeny..." So said Janaka to the marriage party.
notes: There is a lot of commentary from the viewpoint of astrology regarding these stars and days of this marriage. Some have said that uttare divase 'on best day...' phalguni= pūrva phalguni 'pre-Phalguni... on the best day under pre-Phalguni star...' which usually does not happen, but it is also said to be correct by Maheshvara Tiirtha, as the Moon will be in the 12th house at that time, so the marriage is agreeable...' However the stars for best results of marriages are: rohiṇī mṛgaśīrṣyaṇi uttara phalgunī svāti iti vivāhasya nakṣatrāṇi | bodhāyana sūtrāṇi

glosses.meaning: in the day where both Phalguni stars are available
a deity for progeny, namely Bhaga [is the presiding deity]
later, day [later part of the day, or, when the star post-Phalguni is ruling]
for wedding [ceremonies on such a day]

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा वचः सौम्यं प्रत्युत्थाय कृतांजलिः |
उभौ मुनिवरौ राजा जनको वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
evam uktvā vacaḥ sauṃyam pratyutthāya kṛtāñjaliḥ |
ubhau muni varau rājā janako vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: On saying those gracious words thus, king Janaka got up from his throne and coming nigh of both of the eminent-saints, Vishvamitra and Vashishta, reverently said this sentence.

verses.devanagari:
परो धर्मः कृतो मह्यं शिष्योऽस्मि भवतोः सदा |
इमान्यासनमुख्यानि आस्यतां मुनिपुंगवौ
verses.iast:
paro dharmaḥ kṛto mahyam śiṣyo asmi bhavatoḥ sadā |
imāni āsana mukhyāni āsyatām munipuṅgavau
verses.translation: "You two, oh, eminent-saints, have done an excellent generous act in my respect, thus I will ever remain your proselyte... you may please preside over these thrones, that of mine, my brother's, and that of Dasharatha...
notes: The kind deed done by the two sages, Vishvamitra and Vashishta, is fetching right husbands for his daughters, and for his brother's daughters, without flattening his own flatties. And this sitting on the three thrones is for assuming symbolic rulership on the three kingdoms, Ayodhya, Mithila, and Saamkaasya, in getting the marriages performed without a hitch.

glosses.meaning: in my respect, excellent, kind deed [beau geste,] is done
for ever, of yours, proselyte, I am - I remain

verses.devanagari:
यथा दशरथस्येयं तथाऽयोध्या पुरी मम |
प्रभुत्वे नास्ति सन्देहो यथार्हं कर्तुमर्हथ
verses.iast:
yathā daśarathasya iyam tathā ayodhyā purī mama |
prabhutve na asti sandeho yathā arham kartum arhathaḥ
verses.translation: "As to how this city Mithila appertains to Dasharatha, in the same way city of Ayodhya is mine... and there shall be no hesitancy for you two sages in governance on these three kingdoms, thus it will be apt of you to make the marriages happen as aptly as you can..." So said Janaka to the sages.

glosses.meaning: Dasharatha's yathaa = as to how it [belongs to]
Ayodhya, city, to me, likewise [Ayodhya belongs to me]
in governance, doubt not, is there, [no need for hesitancy]
as per, aptness, to make happen, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
तथा ब्रुवति वैदेहे जनके रघुनंदनः |
राजा दशरथो हृष्टः प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम्
verses.iast:
tathā bruvati vaidehe janake raghu nandanaḥ |
rājā daśaratho hṛṣṭaḥ pratyuvāca mahī patim
verses.translation: The legatee of Raghu-s king Dasharatha is gladdened while the legatee of Videha is talking in such a hobnobbing way, and he replied king Janaka in this way.

glosses.meaning: in that way [in such a hobnobbing way,] while talking
Raghu's, legatee, king, Dasharatha, is gladdened

verses.devanagari:
युवामसंख्येयगुणौ भ्रातरौ मिथिलेश्वरौ |
ऋषयो राजसंघाश्च भवद्भ्यामभिपूजिताः
verses.iast:
yuvām asaṅkhyeya guṇau bhrātarau mithileśvarau |
ṛṣayo rāja saṅghāḥ ca bhavadbhyām abhipūjitāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, kings of Mithila, Janaka and Kushadhvaja, you two brothers have reverenced inestimable sages and coteries of kings, as such inestimable good manners are treasured in both of you...
notes: Annex: 'As said in good sayings like, 'good company and good discourse are the very sinews of virtue...' as such, your abilities in making these marriages happen will edge out our limited capabilities... and if we commit any mistake unwittingly, that may besmirch your unblemished personality, because for the first time I am marrying my sons, you shall pardon... by the way, you have performed many marriages, concluding that every bride is your own daughter-like, thus we hear... thus, your sitting complacently on intrusting all the works of marriages to us, is infeasible... so, you do all the works and we sit comfortably seeing the celebrations...'

verses.devanagari:
स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रं ते गमिष्यामः स्वमालयम् |
श्राद्धकर्माणि विधिवत् विधास्येति चाब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
svasti prāpnuhi bhadram te gamiṣyāmaḥ svam ālayam |
śrāddha kar.hmāṇi vidhivat vidhāsya iti ca abravīt
verses.translation: "Enjoy that blessedness! Let safe betide you! We now depart to our visitatorial-palace, and we shall customarily carry out the tributary rituals..." Dasharatha said thus.

glosses.meaning: to our, to visitatorial-palace, we depart

verses.devanagari:
तमापृष्ट्वा नरपतिं राजा दशरथस्तदा |
मुनीन्द्रौ तौ पुरस्कृत्य जगामाशु महायशाः
verses.iast:
tam āpṛṣṭvā nara patim rājā daśarathaḥ tadā |
munīndrau tau puraskṛtya jagāma āśu mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: On seeking leave of absence from the sovereign of people, Janaka, that highly renowned king Dasharatha promptly departed from there, keeping both of the eminent-saints afore, namely Vishvamitra and Vashishta.

glosses.meaning: him, sovereign [Janaka,] on seeking [leave of absence]

verses.devanagari:
स गत्वा निलयं राजा श्राद्धं कृत्वा विधानतः |
प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय चक्रे गोदानमुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
sa gatvā nilayam rājā śrāddham kṛtvā vidhānataḥ |
prabhāte kālyam utthāya cakre go dānam uttamam
verses.translation: King Dasharatha on going to his visitatorial-palace has procedurally undertaken the tributary rituals, and on getting up in the next morning, he carried out the initiatory rituals of marriages, in a grand way, in which donation of cows is a part.

glosses.meaning: in grand [way,] cow, donation [samaavartna, snaataka, initiatory rituals]

verses.devanagari:
गवां शतसहस्रं च ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नराधिपः |
एकैकशो ददौ राजा पुत्रानुद्दिश्य धर्मतः
verses.iast:
gavām śata sahasram ca brāhmaṇebhyo narādhipaḥ |
eka ekaśo dadau rājā putrān uddhiśya dharmataḥ
verses.translation: That lord of people king Dasharatha has righteously donated hundred thousand cows to Brahman-s, in the name of each of his four sons.

glosses.meaning: each, to each [of four sons,] intended for

verses.devanagari:
सुवर्णशृंगाः संपन्नाः सवत्साः कांस्यदोहनाः |
गवां शतसहस्राणि चत्वारि पुरुषर्षभः
वित्तमन्यच्च सुबहु द्विजेभ्यो रघुनंदनः |
ददौ गोदानमुद्दिश्य पुत्रा पुत्रवत्सलः
verses.iast:
suvarṇa śṛṅgayaḥ sampannāḥ sa vatsāḥ kāṃsya dohanāḥ |
gavām śata sahasrāṇi catvāri puruṣa ṛṣabhaḥ
vittam anyat ca su bahu dvijebhyo raghu nandanaḥ |
dadau go dānam uddiśya putrāṇām putra vatsalaḥ
verses.translation: In that cow donation ceremony intended for his sons, he that best one among men and the one who is affectionate towards his sons, Dasharatha, the legatee of Raghu-s, has donated on behalf of each of his sons, four hundred thousand cows, that are abundant milkers, and that have golden casings on their horns, and that are with their calves, and along with milking jugs made with bell metal, and he even donated very many other kinds of assets to Brahmans.

verses.devanagari:
सु सुतैः कृतगोदानैर्वृतः सः नृपतिस्तदा |
लोकपालैरिवाभाति वृतः सौम्यः प्रजापतिः
verses.iast:
sa sutaiḥ kṛta go dānaiḥ vṛtaḥ saḥ nṛpatiḥ tadā |
loka pālaiḥ iva ābhāti vṛtaḥ sauṃyaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: On performing the cow donations and samaavartna, snaataka, the initiatory ceremonies of his sons, as well, he that serene king Dasharatha who is amidst the quartet of his sons, shone forth like serene Brahma, who is quartet-faced, with the quartet of Veda-s, and who is the overlord of mankind, amidst the quartet of presiding deities in the quartet of the world.
notes: The 'unnecessarily' repeated word 'quartet' refers to dharma where its manifestation is with four horns, catvārī śṛngā, trayo asya pādā, dve śīrṣe... 'dharma's horns is a quartet, three are its feet, two are its heads...' so on. When read together with 23, 24 verses, the bullish Dasharatha is said to have the quartet of bullhorn like sons, who are being readied to administer dharma in the world.

glosses.meaning: having performed, cow, donation [samaavartna, snaataka, initiatory ceremonies]
world, administrators [four principle deities presiding over the four quarters of world,] encircled
